It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 13, 2021}} The district consists of the area in southern Negros Occidental containing the cities of [[Kabankalan]] and [[Sipalay]], and the municipalities of [[Candoni]], [[Cauayan, Negros Occidental|Cauayan]], [[Hinoba-an]] and [[Ilog, Negros Occidental|Ilog]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=March 13, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Mercedes Alvarez (politician)|Mercedes Alvarez]] of the [[Nationalist People's Coalition]] (NPC).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 13, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
